privacySections.heading: Who we are
privacySections.body: MileTax is a mobile and web app that helps self-employed workers organize records (vehicles, mileage, receipts, expenses, income) for their accountant. Website: https://miletaxe.com. It is not tax software and does not replace a professional. Contact: support@miletaxe.com.

privacySections.heading: Data we collect
privacySections.body: We collect the account email; profile (name, country, province or state, occupation, units, language); a phone number if you provide one (including for staff accounts); vehicles and, if you enter them, plate, VIN and notes; odometer readings; meter and receipt photos; amounts, tax, merchants, categories, notes and the payment method you record on a receipt; income; the accountant name and email you enter; preparatory packages and files you generate; correction logs you confirm; and, if you use help, support conversation content. Passwords are handled by the authentication provider; we do not store them in plain text. We do not collect GPS location: mileage comes from odometer readings you confirm. We do not collect card numbers: a receipt payment method is a label (cash, card, etc.). We do not sell your data.

privacySections.heading: Photos and automated reading
privacySections.body: Receipt and odometer photos are stored in a private space tied to your account. Automated reading (on-device or, if configured, an OCR service) suggests fields. If cloud OCR is enabled, the photo is sent to that processor only to suggest fields; the result is then stored on your account for you to confirm. These are suggestions: nothing is saved as an expense or reading until you confirm. Do not photograph identity documents or other files unrelated to your business activity.

privacySections.heading: Cookies and audience measurement
privacySections.body: The miletaxe.com website may use cookies and audience-measurement tools to understand traffic and improve the public site. You can manage preferences in your browser settings. The signed-in app uses session cookies or tokens needed to authenticate you and keep you signed in. Audience tools, if present, apply to the public website, not to the contents of your records in the app.

privacySections.heading: Use and retention
privacySections.body: Data is used to sign you in, organize your records, build the accountant package, provide support, and operate the service (security, abuse prevention). It is kept while the account exists. You can export a JSON copy and delete the account in the app, which removes records, associated photos and the account. After deletion, technical copies (backups) may remain for a short operational period, then expire. Records cannot be recovered once deletion is complete.

privacySections.heading: Sharing
privacySections.body: Your records remain yours. The accountant name and email you enter do not trigger automatic sending. If you share a PDF, you send it. Hosting and authentication processors (Supabase) handle data to operate the service, limited to the authenticated account. Resend is used only to send hire emails to our agents (access link, temporary password); it does not receive client records and is not used for marketing. MileTax staff access a file only when needed for support you requested, for service security, or to comply with the law.

privacySections.heading: Hosting and transfers
privacySections.body: Infrastructure (hosting, authentication, file storage) and some processors (staff email, OCR if enabled) may be located outside Quebec or Canada. These transfers are made only to provide the service. For details: support@miletaxe.com.

privacySections.heading: Security
privacySections.body: We use encrypted connections (HTTPS), account authentication and per-user isolation of records. Photos sit in private storage tied to your account. No measure is foolproof: protect your password and account email.

privacySections.heading: Your rights
privacySections.body: Under PIPEDA and, in Quebec, Law 25, you may access, correct and obtain a copy of your information, withdraw consent where the law allows, and delete the account in the app. For a written request: support@miletaxe.com. You may also complain to the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec or, federally, the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

privacySections.heading: Children
privacySections.body: MileTax is for self-employed workers. The service is not intended for anyone under 18; by creating an account, you confirm you have reached the age of majority in your province or country of residence.

privacySections.heading: Changes
privacySections.body: We may update this policy. The date at the top of the page is the version in force. The current version is always published at https://miletaxe.com/legal/privacy.

privacySections.heading: Contact
privacySections.body: For questions about this policy or to exercise your rights, write to support@miletaxe.com (person responsible for the protection of personal information). MileTax — https://miletaxe.com.

termsSections.heading: Acceptance
termsSections.body: By creating an account or using MileTax (mobile app or https://miletaxe.com), you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

termsSections.heading: Service
termsSections.body: MileTax organizes your business records; it does not replace an accountant. It prepares a package for your accountant, but does not file tax returns, compute tax, or provide legal or tax advice.

termsSections.heading: Accuracy
termsSections.body: You are responsible for the amounts, dates, categories and readings you confirm. Displayed totals are sums of what you entered, not a tax figure. OCR suggestions must be reviewed before saving. Keep your originals (receipts, logs, statements).

termsSections.heading: Account
termsSections.body: You must provide a valid email, protect your password and be at least 18. You are responsible for activity on your account. You may export your data and delete the account at any time. After deletion, records cannot be recovered.

termsSections.heading: Availability
termsSections.body: The service is provided “as is”. We may change, interrupt or remove features, including for maintenance or security. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or the absence of errors.

termsSections.heading: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Do not use the app for illegal purposes, identity fraud, or uploads you have no right to store. Photos must relate to your business activity. We may suspend or close an account in case of abuse, a security risk, or a legal requirement.

termsSections.heading: Intellectual property
termsSections.body: MileTax content, brand and operation belong to us. Documents and data you upload remain yours; you grant us only the right to process them to provide the service.

termsSections.heading: Third-party services
termsSections.body: The app may rely on app stores, a host (Supabase), staff email (Resend) and, if configured, an OCR service. Those services have their own terms. MileTax does not automatically send your records to your accountant.

termsSections.heading: Limitation of liability
termsSections.body: To the extent permitted by law, MileTax is not liable for losses related to a tax filing, a penalty, a miscategorized item, or an OCR reading you did not correct. Keep your originals. Nothing in these terms limits mandatory consumer-protection rights.

termsSections.heading: Changes to the terms
termsSections.body: We may update these terms. The date at the top of the page is the version in force, published at https://miletaxe.com/legal/terms. If you keep using the service after an update, you accept the new version.

termsSections.heading: Governing law
termsSections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Quebec and Canada. Quebec courts have jurisdiction, subject to mandatory consumer-protection rights.

landing.metaTitle: MileTax — Your records, ready for your accountant
landing.metaDescription: Organize mileage, receipts, expenses and income. Hand your accountant a clear package. Not tax software. Support: support@miletaxe.com
landing.heroTitle: Your records, ready for your accountant.
landing.heroBody: Photograph the odometer and receipts. File mileage, expenses and income. Export a clear package — without computing tax, without replacing your accountant.
landing.heroNote: MileTax organizes your records. It is not tax advice.
landing.playSoon: Coming to Google Play. Already available here on the web.
landing.problemTitle: Your accountant cannot file a shoebox.
landing.problemBody: Mileage in a notebook, receipts at the bottom of a bag, income in three apps. At year-end you lose time — and often amounts you could have supported.

pains.title: Fuzzy kilometres
pains.body: Without dated odometer readings, the travel file does not hold. Your accountant cannot invent the numbers.

pains.title: Unreadable receipts
pains.body: A photo taken too late, a forgotten amount, a random category. The file becomes incomplete.

pains.title: Nothing ready to hand over
pains.body: You worked all year. You still lack the single, dated package your accountant can open.

features.title: Photographed odometer
features.body: Frame the meter. Confirm the reading. Distance segments are built from your numbers.

features.title: Receipts you confirm
features.body: Automated reading suggests fields. Nothing is saved until you approve it.

features.title: Expenses and income
features.body: File against your province’s catalogs. Totals are sums of what you entered — not a tax figure.

features.title: Accountant package
features.body: A preparatory PDF gathers readings, receipts and income. You send it. Nothing is emailed automatically.

features.title: Your data, your account
features.body: Each file is isolated. Export a copy or delete the account whenever you want.

features.title: Help when you are stuck
features.body: A thread with an agent, without exposing every amount to the whole team.

steps.title: Open the account
steps.body: Email, province, occupation. The app follows your jurisdiction’s catalogs — not a tax calculation.

steps.title: Capture as you go
steps.body: Odometer after a run. Receipt before it vanishes. Income when it lands.

steps.title: Hand over the package
steps.body: When the accountant asks, the file is already there. Keep your originals.

landing.trustTitle: Clear about what MileTax is not.

trust.title: Not tax software
trust.body: No GST/HST amount due, no pre-filled return, no tax advice. Your accountant remains the professional.

trust.title: Confirm before save
trust.body: OCR and suggestions stay proposals. You confirm the amount, date and category.

trust.title: Public legal pages
trust.body: Privacy policy and terms: https://miletaxe.com/legal/privacy and https://miletaxe.com/legal/terms

trust.title: One support address
trust.body: support@miletaxe.com — for a question, an access request, or an account issue.

landing.finalTitle: Stop rebuilding the year in March.
landing.finalBody: Keep the file now. Your accountant will receive something they can read.
